Furthermore, due to the faster training it is much easier to tune the hyperparameters. Langner et al. #ref9# demonstrated that 2D projections of full body MRI volumes can be used to train 2D CNNs to predict different measures like age. Since brain volumes contain less anatomical variation compared to full body volumes, it is not clear if the same approach is well suited for brain volumes. Furthermore, Langner et al. only used mean intensity projections, while we also use the standard deviation projections (to better capture the variation between slices).
